public_rationale: The sustained-valuation condition is not established by the evidence located. Earlier financial disclosures cannot settle a requirement about maintaining valuations after publication. No decisive counterexample meets the early-resolution rule. The unspecified financial basis also prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.
limitations: This is a conditional hold, not a finding that the claim is true.
A finite successful period cannot prove the perpetual requirement.
Choosing an annual or quarterly threshold could change the assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Sustaining AI-trade stock valuations requires every company involved to spend or make hundreds of billions of dollars in perpetuity, increasing every quarter.

statement.excerpt: To sustain the valuation of these stocks — let alone continue growing — will require every company involved to either spend or make hundreds of billions of dollars in perpetuity, increasing every single quarter, without fail.

from_speaker: To sustain the valuation of these stocks
either spend or make hundreds of billions of dollars
increasing every single quarter, without fail
our_interpretation: The scope is the named companies: NVIDIA, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Broadcom, Micron, AMD, CoreWeave and Oracle.
The ordinary reading makes the financial requirement apply separately to each company, rather than to their combined spending or revenue.
The following sentence makes revenue the most natural reading of 'make'. 'Spend' could mean capital expenditure or broader expenditure.
'Hundreds of billions' ordinarily means at least USD 200 billion, but the source supplies no annual or quarterly measurement period.
Sustaining valuations requires evidence of persistence after publication. Merely observing the publication-date price does not establish the condition.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial and valuation evidence establishes that maintaining the named valuations requires each company to meet the stated scale and uninterrupted quarterly growth requirement. A finite period of simultaneous growth and maintained valuations would not establish necessity in perpetuity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented counterexample shows a named company maintaining its publication-date valuation over a meaningful subsequent financial reporting period while neither revenue nor spending satisfies the claimed requirement.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A specified financial basis and a dated record pairing sustained publication-date valuations with subsequent realized revenue and spending, including any quarter that supplies a robust counterexample.
